text: Build job 7, part 1, of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md sections 4 and 10, decision D111): the cutover. Depends on job 6 (incremental checking) having landed and its attribution check passing on main. Choose C0 as main's tip at the time of the run, run the importer (crates/athena-core records_import) against it, write the legacy-exempt record built from athena.toml's [history] exempt (six entries plus 02837e0) to athena/records, make the attribution check judge commits up to C0 by the legacy rule and after it by records only, and stop writing commit-message trailers in new landings. Acceptance: the importer's self-check passes on this repository; athena check --attribution passes on main afterwards; a new landing's commit message has no Athena trailers; the CI attribution job is marked required in its comment and the record of C0 is in docs/decisions.md; .github/workflows/ci.yml and athena.toml are governance deliverables. Files: crates/athena-core, crates/athena-gate, crates/athena-cli, .github/workflows/ci.yml, docs/decisions.md.
